2609.07511.title: Generation of Vectorized Maps Beyond Vehicle View
2609.07511.paper_summary: Autonomous driving relies on High Definition (HD) maps for safe navigation. Traditional HD maps construction is costly in hardware, data and human resources, which together with its update limitations hinders scalability. Recent works have proposed online alternatives for HD vectorized mapping from onboard sensors. However, sensor field of view is limited, and the range of the reconstructed maps ahead of the vehicle is insufficient for safe planning. This paper aims to address this limitation by proposing the novel beyond-view vectorized map generation problem: given vectorized maps of the area sensed by the vehicle (in-view), to generate plausible map continuations. To experimentally assess its feasibility, we propose BeyondFormer, which, to the best of out knowledge, is the first work designed towards beyond-view map generation. Given the novelty of the problem, we generate the first dataset specifically designed for it and evaluate the proposed approach. The results demonstrate consistent performance across diverse scenarios, establishing learning-based methods as a promising direction for map forecasting in autonomous driving. Beyond demonstrating the feasibility of the task, we provide an extensive discussion of the method's limitations and identify key future research directions for scaling it to more complex driving conditions. Code is available at https://git-autopia.car.upm-csic.es/beyondformer.
2609.07511.paper_summary_zh: 自主駕駛依賴高解析度 (HD) 地圖進行安全導航。傳統的 HD 地圖建構在硬體、數據和人力資源上成本高昂，加上其更新的限制，阻礙了可擴展性。最近的研究提出了從車載傳感器進行在線 HD 向量化映射的替代方案。然而，傳感器的視野有限，重建的地圖在車輛前方的範圍不足以進行安全規劃。本文旨在通過提出新穎的超視野向量化地圖生成問題來解決這一限制：給定車輛感知區域的向量化地圖（視野內），生成合理的地圖延續。為了實驗評估其可行性，我們提出了 BeyondFormer，據我們所知，這是首個針對超視野地圖生成設計的工作。鑒於該問題的新穎性，我們生成了第一個專門為其設計的數據集並評估所提出的方法。結果顯示在多種場景中表現一致，確立了基於學習的方法作為自主駕駛地圖預測的一個有前景的方向。除了展示任務的可行性外，我們還提供了對該方法限制的廣泛討論，並確定了將其擴展到更複雜駕駛條件的關鍵未來研究方向。代碼可在 https://git-autopia.car.upm-csic.es/beyondformer 獲得。
